subject: 🌎 A new device is contributing to your Location History
snippet:
Hi Zain
 You previously turned on Location History for your Google Account. You also
 recently signed into a new device, which is now contributing to your
 Location History.
 Location History lets Google give you more personalized information,

subject: Reminder: You have Location History turned on
snippet:
Hi Zain,
 To protect your privacy, this is a reminder that you have Location History
 turned on.
 Location History is a Google Account setting that creates Timeline, a
 personal map that helps you remember places you’ve been, and routes and
 trips
